description.zh:
资源夹名称。

长度为1~24个字符或汉字，可包含汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the folder.

The name must be 1 to 24 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.),and hyphens (-).
The ID of the parent folder.

descriptions.zh:
> 最多支持创建5级资源夹。

本文将提供一个示例，在Root资源夹下，创建一个名为`rdFolder`的资源夹。
descriptions.en:
>  A maximum of five levels of folders can be created under the root folder.

In this example, a folder named `rdFolder` is created under the root folder.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager create-folder --parent-folder-id r-b10000 --folder-name rdFolder --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
